content:
The task was successfully completed by joining medication cost and reimbursement data to evaluate the financial impact of switching to 56-day cycles.
A Python script joined ingredient_cost.csv, card_cost.csv, and reimbursement.csv using medication names and blister card counts. The analysis confirmed that annual drug costs remain constant while margins shift due to reduced packaging fills and reimbursement cycles (12 vs 6). Final decision logic correctly compared the absolute margin difference against a $9,000 threshold to determine the optimal dispensing strategy.
